[4:06PM] #Apapa_Ajegunle #TrafficUpdate 

Vehicular movement from Ojo Road and Otto Wharf remains smooth with fast traffic flow. The same applies to movement from Ajeromi Ifelodun through Baale Street to Boundary Bus Stop, where traffic is also moving freely. However, activity around Boundary Roundabout is relatively slow due to ongoing commercial and market activities in the area.

From Boundary towards the Arrakan Military Cantonment, traffic is steady and without delays. At Marine Beach Bus Stop, inward Ijora, vehicles are moving at a fast pace, while traffic from Ijora Oloopa through the High Bridge to Total and Area B is also flowing freely on both lanes. Outward traffic from Apapa, covering Point Road through Marine Bridge to Iganmu, is equally smooth and without obstruction.

There are no impediments reported at the moment, and our officers are stationed at the major choke points, effectively managing movement and ensuring order.

#FollowLASTMA

[4:53PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

Movement descending from CMS Bridge inward Offin Canal is slow, largely due to market activities and heavy influx. However, traffic eases immediately after Offin Canal towards Eko Bridge by NEPA, where movement is smooth.

Traffic flow on Eko Bridge by NEPA inward CMS Bridge is good.
Descending from Carter Bridge inward Ebute-Ero Market, through Leventis and UBA Roundabout to connect both inner and outer Marina, movement is smooth.

There is slow traffic along Broad Street, stretching to Apongbon underbridge to connect Offin Canal Market.
At present, no major impediments are recorded. Our traffic personnel are on ground managing the situation effectively.

#FollowLASTMA
